title: Adaptive political surveys and GPT-4: Tackling the cold start problem with simulated user interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether using LLM-generated synthetic training data biases the question selection policy of an adaptive questionnaire. The authors compute the 'extremity' of recommended political candidates across different model initializations and compare it to the 'ground truth' extremity of real candidates to measure if the model is biased towards recommending more moderate candidates.
